analyses.primary: Decathlon b6c8b664-e146-464a-bbd7-78d9deb99926 (GB (EN) + FR (FR), 2 categories, 133 kept + 7 unticked)
analyses.substitute: Orange 16cdf040-35aa-42b9-b4e2-e9f6300d50dc (read only: version history panel, TC-006)

environment.organisation: QA-GEO, role SUPER_ADMIN, existing session still valid (no login needed); one transient 503 on /geo/oauth2/authorization/auth0 at 10:32, recovered after 30 s
environment.pool: P = 1000; U = 703 at start and at end (7 analyses both times); b6c8b664 133 slots, 27bec573 80 slots, unchanged
environment.stateChanges: None. A Playwright route aborted every non-GET call to /geo/api during the whole run (write guard). Only two stateless calls were let through: POST /questions/adapt-batch and POST /analysis/translate-category (prompt/category translation, no analysis id). Blocked writes: PATCH /prompts/kept x2 (tick, TC-002), PATCH /prompts/{id}/classification x2 (category select, TC-007), plus the 2 translation calls before they were allowed. Every modal ended with Cancel / Exit and Discard / Escape. Version history of b6c8b664 and 27bec573 still empty at the end. No analysis created or deleted, nothing in the back office.

sideFindings: Ticking an unticked suggestion in Manage Scope > Prompts saves at once (PATCH /reports/{id}/prompts/kept on click, no Save / confirmation). Unticking a single row was not tried; untick-all opens a confirmation ("Untick N prompts", views.manageScope.prompts.untickModalTitle_other). Possibly by design (story: "ticking one keeps it") but the CSV says "ticks one ... and saves". TC-002 stopped.

The row Category select saves on change (PATCH /reports/{id}/prompts/{promptId}/classification), no Save / confirmation; the Type select is expected to do the same. TC-007 stopped, TC-008 not attempted.

No "Suggested Prompts" heading or label in the Manage Scope table: the unticked suggestions are only the last rows, greyed. No i18n key for "Suggested Prompts" (only wizard.promptTable.emptyBody mentions "Suggested prompts"). Check Figma MS frames.

Cancel in Add Country opens "Discard Category" / "Your category creation is incomplete. ..." (wizard.discardChanges.title / description, same strings as views.addCategory.discardTitle / discardDescription): wrong wording for a country. No views.addMarket discard key exists.

Untick warning on the last prompts of a group names the group, not the metrics: "This is the last Reputation prompt of Sporting Goods in United Kingdom (EN)." (stopWarning.groupInCategory). The metric lines (e.g. stopWarning.perception) probably appear only when the type disappears from the whole analysis (not verified). AC-5 / rules say "the warning names the metrics of that type". Also the market reads "United Kingdom (EN)" there vs "GB (EN)" in the table.
Delete Prompt confirmation does not name the prompt being deleted (views.manageScope.prompts.deleteModalNextRun only).
Version history shows markets as "France (French)" while the table uses "FR (FR)".
Add Category > Prompts step: FR rows show the category as "Cycling" though the FR translation is "Cyclisme"; Add Category has no Back button on its Prompts step (Add Country has one).
csvProposals: TC-002 step 2 expected: "The unticked suggestions are listed last, greyed, after the kept prompts" (no "Suggested Prompts" label in the UI), unless the PO confirms a heading is required.
TC-002 step 3: "And the user ticks one suggested prompt" / expected "The tick is saved at once; the ring increases by 1 and G is kept" (no Save step).

TC-007 / TC-008 step 2: "When the user changes the category (type) of K with the row select" / expected "The change is saved at once and the toast 'Prompt moved. Past results stay under the previous category and type; new results start on the next analysis re-run.' is shown" (views.manageScope.prompts.reclassifiedNextRun).

TC-009 step 1 / TC-010 step 1 expected: use the real labels "Add Country" / "Add Category"; TC-009 step 3 expected: '"Add Country" stays disabled with "Tick at least one prompt to add this country."'.
TC-005: add the untick path (untick-all of the group shows the same warning) and state the exact expected warning text once the PO confirms whether the metrics must be named for a group-level loss.
TC-002/003/004/006/007/008/009/010 precondition: add "Needs setup: changes saved on a QA analysis (not allowed on shared analyses)" so they are planned with a dedicated disposable analysis.

results.title: Manage Scope Prompts shows the wizard's table, filters and pool tracker
results.description: Verify that the Prompts section of Manage Scope shows the wizard's table, filters and pool tracker, without per-country or per-type tabs and without the per-group Reset button. Covers AC-1.

steps.title: Given the user is on the dashboard of analysis A
steps.expected: Manage Scope is reachable
steps.observed: Decathlon b6c8b664 dashboard; "Manage Scope" link in the sidebar (/manage-scope)

steps.title: When the user opens Manage Scope > Prompts
steps.expected: The Prompts section is displayed
steps.observed: Manage Scope page with the "Prompts" section (views.manageScope.prompts.title) and its subtitle, "Version history" button, "Add prompt"

steps.title: Then the wizard's table is shown
steps.expected: Columns "Prompt", "Category", "Type", "Market", "Actions" in one table; no per-country or per-type tabs; no Reset button
steps.observed: One table, column headers Prompt / Category / Type / Market / Actions (wizard.promptTable.col*, displayed uppercase by CSS); 0 role=tab / tablist; no button containing "Reset"

steps.title: And the wizard's filters are shown
steps.expected: Category, Type and Market header menus and the Show prompts menu
steps.observed: Header menus "Sort and filter Category" (Sporting Goods 60, Outdoor Gear 60, Other 0, Overview 20), "Sort and filter Type" (Visibility 40, Reputation 40, Competitive 40, Brand Image 20, Other 0), "Sort and filter Market" (GB (EN) 70, FR (FR) 70) and "Show prompts" (All / Selected only / Unselected only)

steps.title: And the pool tracker is shown
steps.expected: The ring "U / P" with its popover
steps.observed: Ring "703 / 1000 prompts · 133 selected"; hover popover "Prompt pool 703 of 1000 · In use by other analyses 570 · Kept in this analysis 133 · Free in the pool 297" (wizard.pool.*)

results.notes: Read-only TC. "Other (0)" in the Category and Type menus is the known flag-ON behaviour.

results.title: Retained unticked suggestions show under Suggested Prompts and can be ticked when the pool has room
results.description: Verify that retained unticked suggestions show greyed under Suggested Prompts at the end of the table, and that ticking one keeps it from the next run when the pool has room. Covers AC-2. The no-room case is covered by TC-GEO-1236-004. Needs setup: a later collection to see the prompt collected.

steps.title: Given the user is on Manage Scope > Prompts of analysis A
steps.expected: The kept prompts are listed
steps.observed: 140 rows: 133 kept prompts ticked first

steps.title: When the user scrolls to the end of the table
steps.expected: The unticked suggestions are listed, greyed, under Suggested Prompts
steps.observed: The 7 unticked suggestions are the last 7 rows (GB (EN), Overview, Brand Image), greyed (prompt text #94a3b8 vs #1e293b). No "Suggested Prompts" heading, label or separator row is displayed (and no such i18n key exists; wizard.promptTable.emptyBody only says "Suggested prompts appear at the end of the table")

steps.title: And the user ticks one suggested prompt and saves
steps.expected: The ring increases by 1 and G is kept
steps.observed: STOPPED: ticking suggestion G "What do you think of Decathlon?" sends PATCH /reports/{id}/prompts/kept immediately (no Save step). The write guard aborted it: banner "Failed to update the prompt. Please try again." (views.manageScope.prompts.genericError), checkbox reverted, ring stayed 703 / 1000. requires saving a change on an existing analysis — not allowed (user decision 2026-10-20)

steps.title: Then G is kept from the next run
steps.expected: G is collected and appears in the results of the next run only; the tick is not written in the version history
steps.observed: Not verified — needs a saved tick and a later collection

results.notes: Steps verified: 1, 2 (partly: at the end + greyed, but no "Suggested Prompts" label). Not verified: 3, 4. Side finding: ticking auto-saves (see side findings). Write guard = Playwright route aborting every non-GET call to /geo/api.

results.title: Editing a prompt in Manage Scope changes only its wording, from the next run
results.description: Verify that editing a prompt in Manage Scope and saving changes only its wording, applied from the next run. Covers AC-3. Needs setup: a later collection after the edit.

steps.title: Given a kept prompt K of analysis A collected in past runs
steps.expected: K shows its original wording
steps.observed: K = "Best Sporting Goods?" (Sporting Goods, Visibility, GB (EN)), ticked, shows its original wording

steps.title: When the user edits the wording of K and saves
steps.expected: K shows the new wording; category, type, market and ticked state are unchanged
steps.observed: Edit prompt turns the cell into an inline input; wording changed to "Best Sporting Goods? in 2026"; category, type, market and tick unchanged while editing. Enter opens the "Save Changes" modal: "Only the wording changes. Results from past runs stay as they are; the new wording is asked from the next analysis re-run." (views.manageScope.prompts.editModalTitle / editModalNextRun) with Cancel / Save Changes. Cancel used: K back to "Best Sporting Goods?", no write request sent. Save not clicked

steps.title: Then past results keep the original wording
steps.expected: The last run shows K with its original wording
steps.observed: requires saving a change on an existing analysis — not allowed (user decision 2026-10-20) (and a later collection)

steps.title: And the next run uses the new wording
steps.expected: The next run shows K with the new wording
steps.observed: requires saving a change on an existing analysis — not allowed (user decision 2026-10-20) (and a later collection)

results.notes: Steps verified: 1 and step 2 up to the save confirmation. Not verified: the saved wording, steps 3 and 4.

results.title: Deleting a prompt frees its slot and keeps its past data points
results.description: Verify that deleting a prompt in Manage Scope asks for confirmation (no Undo), returns its slot to the pool and keeps its past data points in the history. Covers AC-4.

steps.title: Given a kept prompt K of analysis A with past data points
steps.expected: The ring reads "X / P"
steps.observed: K = "What do you think of Decathlon for Sporting Goods?" (Sporting Goods, Reputation, GB (EN)); ring reads "703 / 1000"

steps.title: When the user clicks the trash icon of K
steps.expected: A confirmation opens
steps.observed: Trash icon opens the "Delete Prompt" confirmation: "Its slot returns to the prompt pool. Results from past runs stay in the history; the prompt is no longer asked from the next analysis re-run." (views.manageScope.prompts.deleteModalTitle / deleteModalNextRun), buttons Cancel / Delete Prompt

steps.title: And the user confirms
steps.expected: K is removed from the table, with no Undo toast
steps.observed: Not confirmed — requires saving a change on an existing analysis — not allowed (user decision 2026-10-20). Cancel used: K still listed, 140 rows, ring 703 / 1000

steps.title: Then its slot returns to the pool
steps.expected: The ring reads "X - 1 / P"
steps.observed: Not verified (needs the confirmed deletion)

steps.title: And its past data points stay in the history
steps.expected: The past results of K are still shown
steps.observed: Not verified (needs the confirmed deletion)

results.notes: Steps verified: 1, 2. Not verified: 3, 4, 5 (removal, no Undo toast, ring X - 1, past data kept).

results.title: The last prompt of a group can be deleted with a warning naming the metrics that stop

steps.expected: The changes are saved

results.title: Adding a market brings fresh suggestions, all ticked, with the pool in view
results.description: Verify that adding a market in Manage Scope brings fresh suggestions for it, all ticked, with the pool in view; what the user unticks joins the retained set (Suggested Prompts), and the market cannot be saved with no ticked prompt nor over the pool. Covers AC-8.

steps.title: Given the user is in Manage Scope of analysis A
steps.expected: Add market is available
steps.observed: "Add Country" button (views.manageScope.addMarket) in Analysis Scope > Countries

steps.title: When the user adds a market
steps.expected: Fresh suggestions for Spain are generated, all ticked, with the pool ring in view
steps.observed: Add Country > Spain, language auto-set to Spanish (ES) > Next: 70 Spanish suggestions for ES (ES) (Overview/Brand Image, Sporting Goods and Outdoor Gear x Reputation/Visibility/Competitive), all 70 ticked, ring "773 / 1000 prompts · 70 selected" in the dialog

steps.title: And the user unticks every suggestion of the new market
steps.expected: Save is refused with no ticked prompt
steps.observed: Header checkbox unticks all: ring "703 / 1000 · 0 selected", "Add Country" save button disabled, message "Tick at least one prompt to add this country." (views.addMarket.noKeptPrompt)

steps.title: And the user ticks back all but 3 suggestions and saves
steps.expected: The market is added; the ring reflects the ticked prompts
steps.observed: Ticked all back then unticked 3: ring "770 / 1000 prompts · 67 selected", "Add Country" enabled. Not clicked — requires saving a change on an existing analysis — not allowed (user decision 2026-10-20). Cancel > "Exit and Discard"; scope still GB + FR

steps.title: Then the 3 unticked suggestions join Suggested Prompts
steps.expected: The 3 rows are listed greyed under Suggested Prompts; the new prompts show as "Added" in the version history
steps.observed: Not verified (needs the saved market)

results.notes: Steps verified: 1, 2, 3, and step 4 up to the save point. Not verified: market added, Suggested Prompts rows, "Added" in history. Over-the-pool refusal not tested (297 free slots). The guard first blocked POST /questions/adapt-batch ("Prompt adaptation failed — showing English templates.", views.addMarket.adaptationError); this stateless translation call (no analysis id) was then allowed and the flow replayed.

results.title: Adding a category brings fresh suggestions, all ticked, with the pool in view
results.description: Verify that adding a category in Manage Scope brings fresh suggestions for it in every market, all ticked, with the pool in view, joining the retained set. Covers AC-8.

steps.title: Given the user is in Manage Scope of analysis A
steps.expected: Add category is available
steps.observed: "Add Category" button (views.manageScope.addCategory) in Analysis Scope > Categories

steps.title: When the user adds a category
steps.expected: Fresh suggestions for "Cycling" in GB (EN) and FR (FR) are shown, all ticked, with the pool ring in view
steps.observed: Add Category "Cycling" > AI Sense translations "GB - English: Cycling", "FR - French: Cyclisme" > Next: 60 suggestions (GB (EN) and FR (FR) x Reputation/Visibility/Competitive, 10 each), all ticked, ring "763 / 1000 prompts · 60 selected"

steps.title: And the user saves
steps.expected: The category is added
steps.observed: "Add Category" save button enabled but not clicked — requires saving a change on an existing analysis — not allowed (user decision 2026-10-20). Cancel > "Discard Category" > "Exit and Discard"; categories still Sporting Goods + Outdoor Gear, ring 703 / 1000

steps.title: Then the new prompts join the analysis
steps.expected: The "Cycling" prompts are listed in Manage Scope > Prompts and show as "Added" in the version history
steps.observed: Not verified (needs the saved category)

results.notes: Steps verified: 1, 2. Not verified: 3, 4. The FR rows show the category as "Cycling" (category column) although the FR translation is "Cyclisme" (AI insights language English). POST /analysis/translate-category (stateless) allowed through the guard.
